title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1hbf: Python initiator context_3 uses id_cred_i instead of cred_i for CRED_I
description:
## P1: Python initiator context_3 uses id_cred_i instead of cred_i for CRED_I (pre-existing)

### Problem
`edhoc.py:435`:
```python
context_3 = cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i) + cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i)
```

Per RFC 9529, MAC_3 context should be:
```
MAC_3 = EDHOC_KDF(PRK_4e3m, TH_3, "MAC_3", << ID_CRED_I, CRED_I >>, MAC_LENGTH)
```

So `context_3` should be `cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i) + cbor2.dumps(cred_i)`.

### Current behavior
This happens to work because for by-value-kid RPK, `id_cred_i == cred_i == pubkey`. But it is semantically wrong and would break if a non-by-value-kid credential format were used (different ID_CRED_I vs CRED_I).

### Also affects
The M_3 signature structure (`edhoc.py:441`) has the same pattern:
```python
m_3 = cbor2.dumps(["Signature1", cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i), th_3, cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i), mac_3])
```
Should use `cred_i` not `id_cred_i` for the second credential position.

### Not from this commit
This is pre-existing and not directly caused by the TH_4 fix, but should be addressed for spec compliance.
